# Muhammad Hazqeel

> Full-stack developer and solutions architect in the United Arab Emirates. Builds booking portals, CRMs and web infrastructure for small businesses, plus products and game server systems.

## Client systems
- Shabab Al Khor Mobility Car Wash (Khorfakkan, UAE): end-to-end appointment booking portal and custom CRM with online payments and real-time scheduling. Role: full-stack developer & solutions architect.
- Virgo Lubes (https://www.virgolubes.com/): corporate website, technical SEO, analytics, domains, DNS and hosting. Role: digital infrastructure lead & web developer.
- GHM Global Networks (https://ghmglobalnetworks.vercel.app/): web studio for client sites and automation. Role: founder & developer.

## Products
- Micro-Freelance-Hub (https://micro-freelance-hub.vercel.app/): Next.js and Supabase marketplace for student freelancers.
- Chassis Decoder (https://chassis-decoder.vercel.app/): automotive VIN and chassis number decoder.
- Pixel Planet Healers (https://pixel-planet-healers.lovable.app/): interactive environmental web game.

## Game infrastructure and automation
- Minecraft (Java, Spigot/Paper plugins, Nodes SMP network) and Roblox (Lua) development.
- Local multi-agent workflows with Ollama; scheduled content pipelines.
